label: CV
role: Sole software architect and lead engineer, embedded and real-time
avail: Currently at KM-RoBoTa, aiming to continue my studies at ETH Zurich.

left.heading: Profile
left.text: Embedded and real-time software development, specialised in robotics. Lead author of an IEEE paper (2026) on static dispatch and its impact on real-time architecture.

left.heading: Experience
items: kmr_v3, the architecture of KM-RoBoTa's real-time robot-control SDK: designed and built on my own, as sole software architect and lead engineer.
HAL and firmware in no-std Rust (ARM Cortex-M4), no RTOS: scheduling and drivers written from scratch.
PREEMPT_RT on Arch Linux ARM64: a dedicated Arch Linux package that I created and maintain (kernel patches, configuration, build scripts). Soon publicly available from a file server, then on the AUR.
Full control of a teleoperated robot: Bluetooth and Zenoh, power through an nRF52840, inverse kinematics.

CAN, RS485, TTL, Bluetooth; full rewrite of the Dynamixel SDK in Rust: better error tracking and safety, FFI interface callable from C, and support for every control table, which I scraped from the web by hand because of how heterogeneous they are.
Port of research code (master's, PhD) from C++ to Rust, with the maths ported to my own kmr_v3 design; Dioxus interface for Linux and WASM.
typographus, a log wrapper for Rust: a more convenient, customisable logging system, optimised for performance.
I/O benchmarks and pure static dispatch, allocation-free architectures for the IEEE paper.
Local inference and internal agentic workflows; KM-RoBoTa at the AI for Good Global Summit.

left.heading: Education
left.text:
CFC in IT, application development (Swiss federal VET diploma)
EPSIC, Lausanne. 2023 – 2027, final year.

right.heading: Skills
list: no-std, bare-metal, ARM Cortex-M, CAN, RS485, TTL, Bluetooth, FFI, PREEMPT_RT
local inference, fine-tuning, edge AI, agents

right.text: Dr Kamilo Melo, CEO, KM-RoBoTa SA. Letter of recommendation available (in French).
